title: Resource Allocation and Pressure Creation
sample: 82 NFL defensive-front room-seasons, 2023–2025, with at least 80% opportunity-weighted cap coverage
outcomes: Overall pressure rate and four-man pressure rate, expressed in percentage points
controls: Total Resource Index, concentration, average demonstrated room quality, resource-alignment premium, unproven resource share, continuity, and season fixed effects
cell_format: Coefficient with clustered standard error in parentheses
primary_interpretation: Average demonstrated quality throughout the resourced room was the strongest and most stable predictor of overall and four-man pressure creation. Resource concentration and alignment did not show comparably robust independent effects.
